service-inspection.scope: A useful multi-system visual/operating inspection checklist is a valid complete article. Teach each included quick observation and concrete follow-up. Do not claim a certified full inspection or duplicate every dedicated battery load, coolant concentration, geometry or brake measurement procedure. Link dedicated guides for those follow-on tasks. Perform any wheels-installed drag screening before conditional wheel removal.

brakes.scope: Teach the documented visual brake inspection and package-specific access and restoration; distinguish specification reference values from a measured certification. Do not invent a measuring setup. Optional precision measurements can be routed to a properly equipped inspection without blocking a clearly titled visual-inspection guide.

parking-brake.scope: Teach supported control/cable/release inspection and adjustment. Do not claim that lever feel proves whole-vehicle holding. An unprovided graded-slope certification test is outside the bounded control-and-cable task, not grounds to withhold all supported checks.

steering.scope: Teach installed visual linkage inspection and symptom routing. Do not claim quantitative joint-play certification or derive inspection disassembly from component replacement.

suspension.scope: Use the added ride-height specifications if applicable. A clearly scoped visual/symptom inspection can be complete without unprovided quantitative ball-joint or damper tests; do not certify those tests as passed.

coolant-change.scope: Ford explicitly delegates operation of a compatible vacuum refiller to its manufacturer. Explain the actual vehicle connection, preparation, vacuum-fill workflow and vehicle-specific bleeding checks that Ford supplies. Tool-specific valve controls/vacuum acceptance must follow that tool manual; do not invent universal values or mark Ford’s supported equipment-dependent method missing solely because no one brand is selected.

battery.scope: The official owner battery instructions explicitly require resetting bounce-back after battery disconnection. The owner Power Windows page explains features but does not provide that reset sequence. G1957566 explicitly requires de-initializing existing motors before initialization and supplies a battery-cable-or-fuse interruption method while the window operates. Preserve applicable convertible exclusions, engine-off cable safety and the actual workshop sequence; do not invent a simpler owner reset that is absent. Explain why this is a post-disconnection reset rather than a battery-capacity test.

washers-wipers.scope: The official Washer Fluid Check is now supplied and explicitly instructs filling the reservoir if low. Teach that supported ordinary top-up without inventing a MAX mark, dipstick, numeric capacity or fill depth; the lack of an extra numeric depth is not by itself a missing vehicle procedure. Use practical controlled pouring and observation without claiming a nonexistent indicator.

body-drains-seals.scope: A bounded accessible drain/seal condition inspection is valid. Do not invent hidden drain locations, drilling, trim dismantling or water-test limits; route concealed repairs separately.

seatbelts-latches.scope: Teach the documented inspection/cleaning and latch-operation check. No collision-clearance certification or unsupported pull-load proof is promised. Owner controls now document manual/power front-seat movement and rear seatback return/engagement; teach those normal operating checks by fitted equipment. G1883856 is supplied to resolve the prior missing-reference claim, but do not make a post-replacement full Functional Test a universal routine-check requirement. Keep routine normal-operation checks distinct from replacement/collision certification.

warning-lamps.scope: This is an owner warning-lamp check and response guide, not the entire IPC pinpoint-test library. Explain what the warnings mean and what to do; do not hold it because optional circuit diagnosis requires another procedure. Complete IPC and brake pinpoint diagnostics are reference-only destinations here, not execution evidence. Full cluster system description and owner warning messages/lamp responses are supplied for this bounded owner check.

battery-drain-diagnosis.scope: Teach the supported current measurement and fuse-isolation sequence with actual supplied fuse access. Generator disconnection and module-input tests can remain explicit follow-on branches if unsupported; do not claim to teach their repair or dismantling.

ac-performance-leak-testing.scope: The core performance test and non-invasive leak checks can be fully taught without promising every optional compressor-shaft isolation operation. Keep equipment and engine chart qualifiers explicit. Do not invent universal pressure targets or require compressor removal just for inspecting performance.

driveline-vibration-runout.scope: Separate supported assembled measurements from optional off-car inspection or pinion work. Never borrow a shaft limit for a flange or invent rear-only disconnection clearance. Targeted hand-rotation setup evidence is now supplied: G1686649 explicitly supports suspension at curb height and its first illustration shows the stand beneath the rear lower-arm area; G1693766 establishes Neutral on the hoist; G1693765 supplies released-parking-brake rear-wheel rotation checks. Read these full sources with G2214730 and G1693189. They may support a source-backed engine-off hand inspection/runout setup using the specified twin-post/frame hoist, appropriate stands, all wheels clear before brake release, retained curb-weight shaft angle and final restoration of parking restraints. Independently assess that combined evidence; do not simply repeat the previous missing-evidence statement. Do not import link removal, wheel removal or cable adjustment into the task, and do not claim an energized balancing setup. If specific support geometry remains unresolved, identify exactly what rather than inventing it.

transmission-cooler-backflush.scope: The reference to repeating step9 is resolved by the preceding two timed flushing stages, followed by the inspection-filter branch and five-minute backflush; preserve the actual source sequence. Actual adapter/circuit isolation remains mandatory and cannot be guessed or replaced by complete tube removal.

corrosion-protection.scope: A clearly bounded accessible-surface inspection and treatment guide can be complete without promising hidden-cavity access. Keep concealed-area treatment separately described and do not invent access holes or drilling.

axle-fluid.scope: The original article promises confirming the rear axle fluid schedule and differential type, not a complete lubricant replacement tutorial. Teach the fully supported level-check/top-up route, schedule decision and equipment identification as the executable scope. Do not drain the axle or present conditional replacement instructions while the quantity/modifier/cooler conflicts and no-drain-plug access remain unresolved. Consolidate that unresolved replacement issue in one concise boundary and limitations, not repeated extraction-audit prose. Preserve supported instructions and applicability; do not arbitrarily choose between G2214742 and G2227514 or turn full axle removal into routine service access.

brake-pressure-bleeding.scope: Teach a complete pressure-bleeding procedure for the documented two- and four-piston front-caliper configurations, with applicable rear brakes. Make this equipment restriction explicit in title, introduction and prerequisites. Do not include replacement-master-cylinder priming/reconnection or six-piston bleeder tightening as executable branches while their source torque contradictions remain unresolved. Those distinct configuration/repair branches should be marked outside this article, not selected by guessing a value. This is still a complete brake pressure-bleeding task within its honestly stated supported configurations, not a planning guide. Preserve all supported setup, access, ordering, fluid handling, tightening and completion checks.
